text:
Walk-in is sometimes the solution. It happened to me too. The next day, my visa was expiring, so I went there early in the morning. They asked if I had an appointment, and I said no because my visa was expiring that day.

I waited and waited outside the visa department until all the couple interviews were finished. Then one clerk asked me what I needed. I explained that my visa was due to expire, so he asked me to come inside. He wasn’t even the clerk handling my case. He told me to come back at 3 PM, and when I returned, he gave me my new visa and ID.

Sometimes, it really is just luck. The other clerk had told me to renew it for another three months because they still didn’t have an answer. Luckily, another clerk checked my case, and everything was sorted out. I could finally breathe! 😅
